definition: Objects that shine brightly in the sky, especially the sun or moon.
book: Gulliver's Travels into Several Remote Nations of the World
author: Jonathan Swift
quote: They are well enough acquainted with the motions of those two luminaries, and understand the nature of eclipses; and this is the utmost progress of their astronomy.
example_sentence: The ceremony was attended by luminaries of British theatre.
